books.title: A Study in Scarlet
books.comments: Dr. Watson takes rooms at 221B Baker Street with a consulting detective, and a body in an empty house in Brixton leads back to the American West.

books.title: The Sign of the Four
books.comments: A young woman receives a pearl every year from an unknown sender; Holmes follows the trail to a stolen Indian treasure.

books.title: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes
books.comments: Twelve stories, among them A Scandal in Bohemia, The Red-Headed League and The Speckled Band.

books.title: The Memoirs of Sherlock Holmes
books.comments: Eleven more cases, ending at the Reichenbach Falls with Professor Moriarty.

books.title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
books.comments: A family legend of a spectral hound, a death on Dartmoor, and an heir who may be next.

books.title: The Return of Sherlock Holmes
books.comments: Holmes comes back from the dead in The Empty House, followed by twelve new cases.

books.title: The Valley of Fear
books.comments: A coded warning, a murder at a moated manor house, and a long story of a secret society in Pennsylvania coal country.

books.title: His Last Bow
books.comments: Later cases, closing with Holmes out of retirement on the eve of the First World War.

books.title: The Case-Book of Sherlock Holmes
books.comments: The final twelve stories.

books.title: The Wonderful Wizard of Oz
books.comments: A cyclone carries Dorothy from Kansas to Oz, where she travels the yellow brick road to the Emerald City.

books.title: The Marvelous Land of Oz
books.comments: Tip and a pumpkin-headed man he brought to life escape to the Emerald City, just as General Jinjur's army seizes it.

books.title: Ozma of Oz
books.comments: Shipwrecked with a talking hen, Dorothy lands in Ev and helps rescue its royal family from the Nome King.

books.title: Dorothy and the Wizard in Oz
books.comments: An earthquake drops Dorothy and the Wizard into a land of glass people beneath California.

books.title: The Road to Oz
books.comments: Dorothy and the Shaggy Man wander the roads toward Ozma's birthday party.

books.title: The Emerald City of Oz
books.comments: Dorothy brings Aunt Em and Uncle Henry to live in Oz while the Nome King plots an invasion.

books.title: The Patchwork Girl of Oz
books.comments: Ojo searches Oz for the ingredients of a charm to restore his uncle, with Scraps the patchwork girl.

books.title: Tik-Tok of Oz
books.comments: Betsy Bobbin and the clockwork Tik-Tok join a queen's march against the Nome King.

books.title: The Scarecrow of Oz
books.comments: Trot and Cap'n Bill are swept into Jinxland, where the Scarecrow comes to their aid.

books.title: Rinkitink in Oz
books.comments: Prince Inga sets out with three magic pearls to free his parents and people.

books.title: The Lost Princess of Oz
books.comments: Ozma disappears along with every magic tool in Oz, and search parties set out.

books.title: The Tin Woodman of Oz
books.comments: The Tin Woodman goes looking for the Munchkin girl he once meant to marry.

books.title: The Magic of Oz
books.comments: A boy who knows a transformation word plots with the Nome King against Oz.

books.title: Glinda of Oz
books.comments: Ozma and Dorothy try to stop a war between the Flatheads and the Skeezers.

books.title: Anne of Green Gables
books.comments: The Cuthberts ask for an orphan boy to help on their Prince Edward Island farm and are sent Anne Shirley instead.

books.title: Anne of Avonlea
books.comments: Anne, now sixteen, teaches at the Avonlea school.

books.title: Anne of the Island
books.comments: Anne goes to college in Kingsport.

books.title: Anne's House of Dreams
books.comments: Anne and Gilbert begin married life in a small house at Four Winds Harbour.

books.title: Rainbow Valley
books.comments: Anne's children and the motherless children of the new minister share a hollow they call Rainbow Valley.

books.title: Rilla of Ingleside
books.comments: Anne's youngest daughter comes of age on the home front during the First World War.

books.title: Little Women
books.comments: The four March sisters grow up in Massachusetts while their father serves in the Civil War.

books.title: Little Men
books.comments: Jo and her husband run Plumfield, a school for boys.

books.title: Jo's Boys
books.comments: The Plumfield boys, grown up and scattered.

books.title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
books.comments: Alice follows a White Rabbit down a rabbit hole.

books.title: Through the Looking-Glass
books.comments: Alice steps through a mirror into a world laid out like a chessboard.

books.title: The Adventures of Tom Sawyer
books.comments: A boyhood on the Mississippi: fence-painting, a buried treasure, and a murder witnessed in a graveyard.

books.title: Adventures of Huckleberry Finn
books.comments: Huck escapes his father and travels down the Mississippi on a raft with Jim, who is fleeing slavery.

books.title: The Deerslayer
books.comments: Natty Bumppo's first adventure, on a New York lake during the French and Indian War.

books.title: The Last of the Mohicans
books.comments: Hawkeye and his Mohican friends guide two sisters through the wilderness around Fort William Henry.

books.title: The Pathfinder
books.comments: Natty Bumppo on Lake Ontario, and in love.

books.title: The Pioneers
books.comments: An older Natty Bumppo clashes with the settlers of Templeton.

books.title: The Prairie
books.comments: Natty Bumppo's last days, on the Great Plains.

books.title: The Three Musketeers
books.comments: D'Artagnan comes to Paris and falls in with Athos, Porthos and Aramis against Cardinal Richelieu.

books.title: Twenty Years After
books.comments: The musketeers reunite during the Fronde and the English Civil War.

books.title: The Vicomte of Bragelonne
books.comments: The last of the romances, including the story of the Man in the Iron Mask.

books.title: A Princess of Mars
books.comments: Confederate veteran John Carter wakes on Mars and fights for the princess Dejah Thoris.

books.title: The Gods of Mars
books.comments: John Carter returns to Mars and exposes the religion of the River Iss.

books.title: The Warlord of Mars
books.comments: John Carter pursues Dejah Thoris's kidnappers to the north pole of Mars.

books.title: Thuvia, Maid of Mars
books.comments: John Carter's son Carthoris and the princess Thuvia.

books.title: The Chessmen of Mars
books.comments: Tara of Helium is captured, and played for, in a game of living chess.

books.title: The Master Mind of Mars
books.comments: An Earthman apprenticed to a Martian surgeon who transplants brains.

books.title: Tarzan of the Apes
books.comments: An English lord's orphaned son is raised by apes in the African jungle.

books.title: The Return of Tarzan
books.comments: Tarzan tries civilization in Paris and North Africa, then returns to the jungle.

books.title: The Beasts of Tarzan
books.comments: Tarzan raises a band of animals to rescue his wife and son.

books.title: The Son of Tarzan
books.comments: Tarzan's son runs away to Africa.

books.title: Tarzan and the Jewels of Opar
books.comments: A blow to the head leaves Tarzan without his memory in the lost city of Opar.

books.title: The Mysterious Affair at Styles
books.comments: A wealthy widow is poisoned in an Essex country house, and a Belgian refugee detective investigates.

books.title: The Murder on the Links
books.comments: Poirot answers a call for help and finds the man who sent it dead on a French golf course.

books.title: Poirot Investigates
books.comments: Eleven short cases.

books.title: The Murder of Roger Ackroyd
books.comments: Poirot, retired to grow marrows, is drawn into a village murder.

books.title: The Big Four
books.comments: Poirot against an international criminal organization.

books.title: The Mystery of the Blue Train
books.comments: An heiress is murdered on the train to the Riviera.

books.title: The Secret Adversary
books.comments: Two young friends start a business as adventurers and are soon hunting for a missing treaty.

books.title: The Murder at the Vicarage
books.comments: A disliked colonel is shot in the vicar's study at St. Mary Mead.

books.title: The Innocence of Father Brown
books.comments: The first stories of the unassuming priest who solves crimes by understanding sin.

books.title: The Wisdom of Father Brown
books.comments: Twelve more stories.

books.title: The Incredulity of Father Brown
books.comments: Father Brown faces crimes that seem to have supernatural causes.

books.title: The Secret of Father Brown
books.comments: Father Brown explains his method.

books.title: The Thirty-Nine Steps
books.comments: Richard Hannay is framed for murder and flees across Scotland with a dead man's notebook.

books.title: Greenmantle
books.comments: Hannay crosses wartime Europe to Constantinople.

books.title: Mr Standfast
books.comments: Hannay goes undercover among pacifists to find a German spy.

books.title: The Three Hostages
books.comments: Hannay searches for three hostages held by a criminal mastermind.

books.title: My Man Jeeves
books.comments: The first stories of Bertie Wooster and his valet.

books.title: The Inimitable Jeeves
books.comments: Bertie's friend Bingo Little falls in love, repeatedly.

books.title: Carry On, Jeeves
books.comments: Ten stories, including how Jeeves came to work for Bertie.

books.title: Very Good, Jeeves!
books.comments: Eleven more stories.

books.title: Winnie-the-Pooh
books.comments: Christopher Robin's bear and his friends in the Hundred Acre Wood.

books.title: The House at Pooh Corner
books.comments: Tigger arrives, and Christopher Robin prepares to go away.

books.title: Pride and Prejudice
books.comments: Elizabeth Bennet and Mr. Darcy get off on the wrong foot.

books.title: Sense and Sensibility
books.comments: The Dashwood sisters, one prudent and one passionate, in love and short of money.

books.title: Emma
books.comments: A young woman who considers herself a fine matchmaker.

books.title: Persuasion
books.comments: Anne Elliot meets again the naval officer she was persuaded not to marry.

books.title: Northanger Abbey
books.comments: A reader of Gothic novels visits an abbey and imagines the worst.

books.title: Mansfield Park
books.comments: Fanny Price grows up as the poor relation in her uncle's house.

books.title: Frankenstein
books.comments: A young scientist creates a living being and abandons it.

books.title: Dracula
books.comments: Told in letters and diaries: a Transylvanian count comes to England.

books.title: Moby-Dick
books.comments: Ishmael ships aboard the Pequod, whose captain is hunting one white whale.

books.title: Jane Eyre
books.comments: An orphaned governess and her employer, Mr. Rochester, who has a secret.

books.title: Wuthering Heights
books.comments: Catherine Earnshaw and Heathcliff on the Yorkshire moors, and the wreckage they leave.

books.title: Great Expectations
books.comments: Pip, an orphan, is raised to be a gentleman by an unknown benefactor.

books.title: A Tale of Two Cities
books.comments: London and Paris before and during the French Revolution.

books.title: Bleak House
books.comments: An endless lawsuit in Chancery, and the lives tangled in it.

books.title: Oliver Twist
books.comments: A workhouse orphan falls in with Fagin's gang of London pickpockets.

books.title: David Copperfield
books.comments: A life told from childhood, with Mr. Micawber, Uriah Heep and Betsey Trotwood.

books.title: A Christmas Carol
books.comments: Three spirits visit Ebenezer Scrooge on Christmas Eve.

books.title: The Time Machine
books.comments: A Victorian inventor travels to the year 802,701.

books.title: The War of the Worlds
books.comments: Martians land in Surrey.

books.title: The Invisible Man
books.comments: A scientist makes himself invisible and cannot undo it.

books.title: The Island of Doctor Moreau
books.comments: A shipwrecked man reaches an island where a vivisectionist works on animals.

books.title: Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Seas
books.comments: A naturalist becomes a captive aboard Captain Nemo's submarine, the Nautilus.

books.title: Around the World in Eighty Days
books.comments: Phileas Fogg wagers that he can circle the globe in eighty days.

books.title: Journey to the Centre of the Earth
books.comments: A professor and his nephew descend through an Icelandic volcano.

books.title: Treasure Island
books.comments: Jim Hawkins, a treasure map, and Long John Silver.

books.title: Strange Case of Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde
books.comments: A London lawyer looks into his friend's connection to a violent man.

books.title: Kidnapped
books.comments: David Balfour is sold onto a ship by his uncle and escapes across the Highlands with Alan Breck.

books.title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
books.comments: A portrait ages while the young man it depicts does not.

books.title: Tess of the d'Urbervilles
books.comments: A poor girl learns her family descends from nobility.

books.title: Far from the Madding Crowd
books.comments: Bathsheba Everdene, a farmer, and three very different suitors.

books.title: Jude the Obscure
books.comments: A stonemason dreams of the university at Christminster.

books.title: Middlemarch
books.comments: A study of provincial life, centred on Dorothea Brooke and the doctor Tertius Lydgate.

books.title: War and Peace
books.comments: Russian families through the Napoleonic Wars.

books.title: Anna Karenina
books.comments: A married woman's affair with an officer, alongside Levin's search for meaning on his estate.

books.title: Crime and Punishment
books.comments: A former student in St. Petersburg commits a murder and lives with it.

books.title: The Brothers Karamazov
books.comments: Three brothers and the murder of their father.

books.title: Madame Bovary
books.comments: A doctor's wife in provincial Normandy longs for the life in her novels.

books.title: Les Misérables
books.comments: Jean Valjean, a released convict, is pursued for decades by the inspector Javert.

books.title: The Great Gatsby
books.comments: Nick Carraway's neighbour on Long Island throws parties for one guest who never comes.

books.title: This Side of Paradise
books.comments: Amory Blaine at Princeton and after.

books.title: The Sun Also Rises
books.comments: Expatriates travel from Paris to the bullfights at Pamplona.

books.title: A Farewell to Arms
books.comments: An American ambulance driver on the Italian front and an English nurse.

books.title: Mrs Dalloway
books.comments: One June day in London as Clarissa Dalloway prepares for a party.

books.title: To the Lighthouse
books.comments: The Ramsay family's summers on the Isle of Skye, before and after the war.

books.title: Orlando
books.comments: A biography of a poet who lives for centuries and changes sex.

books.title: Dubliners
books.comments: Fifteen stories of Dublin life, ending with The Dead.

books.title: Ulysses
books.comments: One day in Dublin, 16 June 1904, following Leopold Bloom.

books.title: The Age of Innocence
books.comments: A New York lawyer engaged to a suitable bride falls for her unconventional cousin.

books.title: The House of Mirth
books.comments: Lily Bart, beautiful and unmarried, in New York society.

books.title: Ethan Frome
books.comments: A Massachusetts farmer, his ailing wife, and her young cousin.

books.title: My Ántonia
books.comments: A Bohemian immigrant girl on the Nebraska prairie, remembered by a friend.

books.title: O Pioneers!
books.comments: Alexandra Bergson holds her family's Nebraska farm together.

books.title: Heart of Darkness
books.comments: Marlow travels up the Congo River in search of the ivory trader Kurtz.

books.title: Lord Jim
books.comments: A young mate abandons his ship and spends his life trying to make up for it.

books.title: A Room with a View
books.comments: Lucy Honeychurch in Florence, and the choice that follows her home.

books.title: Howards End
books.comments: The Schlegel sisters, the Wilcoxes, and who will inherit a house.

books.title: A Passage to India
books.comments: An incident in the Marabar Caves divides the English and Indians of Chandrapore.

books.title: Main Street
books.comments: A city-bred young woman marries a doctor and tries to reform a Minnesota town.

books.title: Babbitt
books.comments: A prosperous real-estate agent in Zenith begins to doubt his life.

books.title: Red Harvest
books.comments: The Continental Op sets a corrupt mining town's gangs against each other.

books.title: The Maltese Falcon
books.comments: Sam Spade's partner is shot, and everyone wants a black statuette.

books.title: The Jungle Book
books.comments: Mowgli is raised by wolves; with Rikki-Tikki-Tavi and other stories.

books.title: Kim
books.comments: An Irish orphan in Lahore becomes a lama's disciple and a spy.

books.title: The Secret Garden
books.comments: Mary Lennox, sent to a Yorkshire manor, finds a locked garden.

books.title: A Little Princess
books.comments: A rich pupil at a London boarding school loses everything.

books.title: Peter and Wendy
books.comments: Peter Pan takes the Darling children to Neverland.

books.title: The Wind in the Willows
books.comments: Mole, Rat, Badger and the reckless Mr. Toad.

books.title: The Railway Children
books.comments: Three children move to the country after their father is taken away.

books.title: The Call of the Wild
books.comments: Buck, a stolen dog, is put to work in the Klondike.

books.title: White Fang
books.comments: A wolf-dog's journey from the wild to domestication.

books.title: Captain Blood
books.comments: An Irish doctor transported to Barbados becomes a pirate.

books.title: Scaramouche
books.comments: A lawyer turned actor and swordsman in the French Revolution.

books.title: The Phantom of the Opera
books.comments: A masked figure haunts the Paris Opera and a young soprano.

books.title: The Sound and the Fury
books.comments: The decline of the Compson family, told by four narrators.
